sourceFile: 19-1. BRS-161014  Report test CMG and CPT reduce dimension 17.2.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the changed factor and mispairs function results, so it cannot be used as final evidence.
issues: Primary change is CMG/CPT dimension reduction, not line or total comparison.
E2 GMI, C2 DT, and Total are grouping/result contexts, not changed conditions.
Function outcome mispairs C2 and Total tests against E2 normal instead of matching normal rows.
Function comparison omits required normal rows for C2 and Total.
Header-derived measurement-2 statistics are invalid and should be removed.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to CMG/CPT dimension reduction from old to new dimensions.
Use Normal as baseline and Test/Test Yoke as changed condition.
Pair function rows by same line/date or total: 25 vs 27, 29 vs 31, 33 vs 35.
Keep gauss outcomes grouped by MG+PT, Semi Yoke, and Final with Test vs Normal rows.
Remove row24-only measurement statistics and cite only data-bearing rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but current grouping and pair citations are not sufficient.
